question: Do you ever use TikTok?
dek: 47% of U.S. adults say they do. In every state, adults under 25 use it far more than those 65 and over.
wording: Do you ever use any of the following social media sites or apps? (Please select all that apply) — TikTok

weight.us: weight: the survey team's demographic weight
weight.state: weight_state: demographics, calibrated within each state

suppression: Groups under 10 respondents are withheld; none were
moe: 95% margins, worked out as in the Work report's Table 8: 1.96 × √(p(1 − p) / n) on the unweighted n. They leave out the effect of weighting, so true margins are somewhat wider; the MCP doesn't serve its own yet (#273). States rest on {nLo} to {nHi} respondents each, an age group within a state on as few as {cellMin}. Groups under 100 are starred: interpret with caution.

radio.us: Nearly half of American adults, {usWords}, say they use TikTok, according to a CHIP50 survey of more than 31,000 adults this spring. Use falls steeply with age: about seven in ten adults under 25 use the app, against about one in five of those 65 and older.
